article.title: Acceptance for honour.
article.content: When a bill of exchange has been noted or protested for non-acceptance or for better security, any person not being a party already liable thereon may, with the consent of the holder, by writing on the bill, accept the same for the honour of any party thereto. 1***
article.html:
108Acceptance for honour.

Section 108 · Chapter XI · page 24 of the Act

When a bill of exchange has been noted or protested for non-acceptance or for better security, any person not being a party already liable thereon may, with the consent of the holder, by writing on the bill, accept the same for the honour of any party thereto. 1***

1 The second sentence rep. by Act 2 of 1885, s. 7.
